```typescript
/**
 * mech — seed.ts
 * Pure markdown parser: mindmap.md → structured branch/leaf data.
 * Zero I/O. Zero pi imports. Testable in isolation.
 */
import type {
  BranchStatus,
  Bottleneck,
  BranchState,
  Leaf,
  LeafStatus,
  QALevel,
  TestStrategy,
  Posture,
  BranchQuality,
} from "./types";
import { emptyEvidence } from "./types";
import { assignModel, assignTools } from "./config";

// ── Emoji → status maps ───────────────────────────────────────
export const LEAF_EMOJI_MAP: Record<string, LeafStatus> = {
  "⬜": "pending",
  "🔄": "in_progress",
  "⏳": "submitted",
  "🔴": "blocked",
  "💤": "abandoned",
  "✅": "done",
};

export const BRANCH_EMOJI_MAP: Record<string, BranchStatus> = {
  "⬜": "pending",
  "🔄": "in_progress",
  "✅": "done",
  "🔴": "blocked",
  "💤": "abandoned",
};

// ── Parsed structures ─────────────────────────────────────────
export interface ParsedLeaf {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: LeafStatus;
  bottleneck: Bottleneck;
  qa: QALevel;
  test: TestStrategy[];
  specPath?: string;
  needs: string[];
  needsContract: string[];
  estLoc?: number;
  human: boolean;
}

export interface ParsedBranch {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  level: number;
  status: BranchStatus;
  tags: string[];
  scope?: string;
  quality?: BranchQuality;
  leaves: ParsedLeaf[];
  subBranches: string[];
  childBranchStatus: Record<string, BranchStatus>;
  posture?: Posture;
}

// ── parseLeafLine ─────────────────────────────────────────────
export function parseLeafLine(line: string): ParsedLeaf | null {
  // Match: - emoji name → path [tags]
  const match = line.match(/^-\s*(⬜|🔄|⏳|🔴|💤|✅)\s+(.+?)(?:\s+→\s+(.+?))?\s*(.*)$/);
  if (!match) return null;
  
  const emoji = match[1];
  const name = match[2].trim();
  const specPath = match[3]?.trim();
  const tagsStr = match[4]?.trim() ?? "";
  
  const status = LEAF_EMOJI_MAP[emoji] ?? "pending";
  
  // Extract tags
  const qa = extractTag(tagsStr, "qa") as QALevel ?? "review";
  const test = extractTags(tagsStr, "test").length > 0 
    ? extractTags(tagsStr, "test") as TestStrategy[] 
    : ["unit"];
  const needs = extractTags(tagsStr, "needs");
  const needsContract = extractTags(tagsStr, "needs-contract");
  const bottleneck = extractTag(tagsStr, "bottleneck") as Bottleneck ?? "standard";
  const estLoc = extractTagInt(tagsStr, "est-loc");
  const human = tagsStr.includes("[human]");
  
  // Derive leaf ID from spec path or name
  const id = specPath 
    ? specPath.split("/").pop()?.replace(/\.spec\.md$/, "") ?? slugify(name)
    : slugify(name);
  
  return {
    id,
    name,
    status,
    bottleneck,
    qa,
    test,
    specPath,
    needs,
    needsContract,
    estLoc,
    human,
  };
}

// ── parseMapToBranches ────────────────────────────────────────
export function parseMapToBranches(content: string): ParsedBranch[] {
  const lines = content.split("\n");
  const branches: ParsedBranch[] = [];
  const branchStack: ParsedBranch[] = [];
  
  for (const line of lines) {
    // Branch heading: ## name emoji [tag] — scope: desc · progress
    const headingMatch = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/);
    if (headingMatch) {
      const level = headingMatch[1].length;
      const rest = headingMatch[2];
      
      // Parse heading: name emoji [tags] — scope: desc · progress
      const { name, status, tags, scope } = parseBranchHeading(rest);
      
      // Pop stack until we find a parent with lower level
      while (branchStack.length > 0 && branchStack[branchStack.length - 1].level >= level) {
        branchStack.pop();
      }
      
      // Create branch
      const branch: ParsedBranch = {
        id: slugify(name),
        name,
        level,
        status: status ?? "pending",
        tags,
        scope,
        leaves: [],
        subBranches: [],
        childBranchStatus: {},
      };
      
      // Set quality from tags or posture
      if (tags.includes("module") || tags.includes("feature")) {
        branch.quality = "fast";
      }
      
      // Add as sub-branch of parent
      if (branchStack.length > 0) {
        const parent = branchStack[branchStack.length - 1];
        parent.subBranches.push(branch.id);
        parent.childBranchStatus[branch.id] = branch.status;
      }
      
      branches.push(branch);
      branchStack.push(branch);
      continue;
    }
    
    // Leaf line: - emoji name → path [tags]
    if (line.startsWith("- ")) {
      const leaf = parseLeafLine(line);
      if (leaf && branchStack.length > 0) {
        branchStack[branchStack.length - 1].leaves.push(leaf);
      }
      continue;
    }
  }
  
  return branches;
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
function parseBranchHeading(text: string): {
  name: string;
  status: BranchStatus | null;
  tags: string[];
  scope?: string;
} {
  // Format: name emoji [tag] — scope: desc · progress
  // Or: name emoji [tag] — scope: desc
  // Or: name emoji [tag]
  
  // Extract tags
  const tagMatches = text.match(/\[(\w+)\]/g) ?? [];
  const tags = tagMatches.map(t => t.slice(1, -1));
  
  // Extract emoji
  const emojiMatch = text.match(/(⬜|🔄|⏳|🔴|💤|✅)/);
  const status = emojiMatch ? (BRANCH_EMOJI_MAP[emojiMatch[1]] ?? null) : null;
  
  // Extract name (before emoji or tags)
  let namePart = text;
  if (emojiMatch) {
    namePart = text.slice(0, emojiMatch.index).trim();
  }
  // Remove tags from name
  namePart = namePart.replace(/\[(\w+)\]/g, "").trim();
  // Remove scope part
  namePart = namePart.split(" — ")[0].trim();
  
  // Extract scope
  const scopeMatch = text.match(/—\s*scope:\s*(.+?)(?:\s*·\s*|$)/);
  const scope = scopeMatch ? scopeMatch[1].trim() : undefined;
  
  return { name: namePart, status, tags, scope };
}

function extractTag(tagsStr: string, tag: string): string | undefined {
  const match = tagsStr.match(new RegExp(`\\[${tag}:\\s*([^\\]]+)\\]`));
  return match ? match[1].trim() : undefined;
}

function extractTags(tagsStr: string, tag: string): string[] {
  const matches = tagsStr.match(new RegExp(`\\[${tag}:\\s*([^\\]]+)\\]`, "g")) ?? [];
  return matches.map(m => m.replace(new RegExp(`\\[${tag}:\\s*`, "i"), "").replace(/\]$/, "").trim());
}

function extractTagInt(tagsStr: string, tag: string): number | undefined {
  const val = extractTag(tagsStr, tag);
  return val ? parseInt(val, 10) : undefined;
}

function slugify(text: string): string {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}

export interface ValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
}

export function validateBranchState(state: BranchState): ValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  
  // Check branchId
  if (!state.branchId || state.branchId.trim() === "") {
    errors.push("branchId is required");
  }
  
  // Check status
  const validBranchStatuses: BranchStatus[] = ["pending", "in_progress", "done", "blocked", "abandoned"];
  if (!validBranchStatuses.includes(state.status)) {
    errors.push(`invalid branch status: ${state.status}`);
  }
  
  // Check leaves
  for (const [id, leaf] of Object.entries(state.leaves)) {
    if (!leaf.id) {
      errors.push(`leaf ${id} has no id`);
    }
    const validLeafStatuses: LeafStatus[] = ["pending", "in_progress", "submitted", "in_review", "blocked", "abandoned", "done"];
    if (!validLeafStatuses.includes(leaf.status)) {
      errors.push(`leaf ${id} has invalid status: ${leaf.status}`);
    }
    // Check evidence
    if (!leaf.evidence) {
      errors.push(`leaf ${id} has no evidence`);
    }
  }
  
  // Check transitions
  for (const t of state.transitions) {
    if (!t.leaf || !t.from || !t.to || !t.timestamp || !t.evidenceHash) {
      errors.push(`invalid transition entry: ${JSON.stringify(t)}`);
    }
  }
  
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
}
```

export interface OrchestratedResult {
  ok: boolean;
  summary: string;
  failures: string[];
  newState?: BranchState;
}

export async function applySubmitLeaf(
  leafId: string,
  evidence: Partial<LeafEvidence>,
  statePath: string = ".morphmap/state.json",
  allowedChanges?: string[],
  graph?: DependencyGraph,
  allLeaves?: Record<string, Leaf>,
): Promise<OrchestratedResult> {
  const state = await loadState(statePath);
  if (!state) {
    return { ok: false, summary: "no .morphmap/state.json", failures: ["no .morphmap/state.json"] };
  }
  
  const result = submitLeaf(state, { leafId, evidence, allowedChanges, graph, allLeaves });
  if (result.accepted) {
    await saveState(result.newState, statePath);
    const summary = result.transitioned 
      ? `leaf '${leafId}' submitted` 
      : `leaf '${leafId}' already submitted (idempotent)`;
    return { ok: true, summary, failures: [], newState: result.newState };
  }
  
  return {
    ok: false,
    summary: `submission rejected: ${result.failures.join(", ")}`,
    failures: result.failures,
    newState: state,
  };
}
